subject: MAP: POC environment wiring & ownership (API keys, org + allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Andrea Lopez <andrea@heliomed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Helio Network <ops@heliomed.com>, Peter Chen <peter.chen@cloudinfra.io>
Date: 2026-09-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Heliomed MAP kickoff: POC environment requirements and timeline

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Leadership is on board to run a two-week POC, and they asked me to share our constraints so we can lock a MAP and get to a close date. High level we need:

- Short-lived API credentials for the POC team (service account preferred)
- Org-level onboarding so our infra team can create tenant isolation
- IP allowlist entries for our staging CIDR (10.12.0.0/20)
- VPC peering between our GCP project and Redwood-managed VPC (we’ll own our side)

Can you confirm what information you need from us for each item and proposed owners on both sides? We’re targeting environment-ready in 7 business days so engineering can start integration tests.

Attached: a brief Heliomed internal checklist.

Appreciate a tight checklist and a short MAP so procurement can sign off.

Best,
Andrea
Andrea Lopez
Head of Platform Operations, Heliomed
Attachment: helio_internal_poc_list.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Lopez <andrea@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Peter Chen <peter.chen@cloudinfra.io>
Date: 2026-09-18 12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Heliomed MAP kickoff: POC environment requirements and timeline

Andrea —

Great — congrats on the green light. Below is a pragmatic MAP draft focused only on the POC wiring so your team can run integration tests within your 7-business-day target. I attached a one-tab MAP template (redwood-map-template.xlsx) you can edit.

High-level owners and required artifacts:

1) API credentials (Karthik [RWI], Andrea/Heliomed engineer [Heliomed])
   - Redwood produces a scoped service account and short-lived API key pair (expires after POC).
   - We need: Helio owner email, caller IP ranges (if IP-restricted keys), and desired scopes.

2) Org setup / tenant isolation (Neha [RWI], Helio SRE [Heliomed])
   - Action: Neha will create the tenant entry and mapping to Helio project IDs.
   - We need: billing/project IDs + preferred internal team contact.

3) IP allowlist (Marissa [RWI], Helio Network Ops [Heliomed])
   - Action: Marissa to validate CIDR and add to staging allowlist.
   - We need: exact CIDR(s) and any NAT egress IPs.

4) VPC peering (Neha + Infra team for coordination; Peter Chen looped for cloud infra advice)
   - Action: exchange peering request, validate routes, schedule one maintenance 30-min window to accept.
   - We need: VPC names, project IDs, and preferred maintenance window.

Proposed timeline (fast lane):
- Day 0: Sign MAP + confirm owners and artifacts (today)
- Day 1–2: Redwood issues API keys and creates tenant entry
- Day 2–3: Helio provides CIDR and project IDs; Redwood adds allowlist
- Day 3–4: VPC peering exchange and route validation (30–60m planned window)
- Day 5: Integration smoke tests by Helio; quick rollback plan if routing blocks appear

Next steps: can you confirm owners and fill the attached MAP template? I’ll coordinate with Neha and Marissa for the peering checklist and keys.

Small ask: we recommend a single point-of-contact for the POC (Helio SRE) to avoid fragmentation.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-minute technical handshake for tomorrow morning.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-map-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19 08:45 -0700
Subject: Internal: Helio POC wiring — who owns which piece? (quick)

Marissa / Neha —

Looping you both in to confirm feasible turnaround and any blockers. Short notes below; please reply with any time estimates and any further artifact requirements.

Marissa (IP allowlist):
- Helio CIDR: 10.12.0.0/20 (they may NAT; ask for egress IPs).
- Can we add staging CIDR to allowlist within 24 hours? Any approvals needed?

Neha (Org + VPC peering):
- Org: create tenant mapping to project IDs — low friction, ~1 hour.
- Peering: we’ll need the Helio VPC name + project ID; I’ll send the standard peering checklist. If Helio wants route propagation, we need to confirm routes and agree a 30–60m maintenance window.

Attachments I’m sending to them: vpc-peering-checklist.pdf and the MAP template. I’ll also include a short acceptance test list for their smoke runs.

If both of you can confirm today, I’ll push the MAP and keys out tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Karthik

- Owner: Helio SRE is Dan Huang (dan.huang@heliomed.com) — he’ll be the single POC contact.
- CIDR: 10.12.0.0/20 (we will NAT; our egress IPs are 34.89.210.45 and 34.89.210.46)
- GCP project: helio-staging-01, VPC name: helio-staging-vpc
- Maintenance window: 2026-09-22 02:00–02:30 PT (low traffic)

We’ve attached our filled MAP and a short list of smoke tests. Please proceed with issuing the scoped API key and tenant mapping. Dan will be on the 09/22 maintenance call.

If Redwood can produce the API credentials and add the allowlist by EOD 09/21, we’ll run smoke tests 09/22 and share results the same day. That keeps us inside the 7-business-day goal.

Appreciate the fast lane.

Best,
Andrea
